entries.name: IGDB API
entries.category: Metadata APIs
entries.licence: Free for non-commercial use under the Twitch Developer Service Agreement; commercial use needs a partnership
entries.takedown_note: n/a
entries.required_files: Twitch developer Client ID + Client Secret (OAuth client-credentials token)
entries.launch_cli: POST https://api.igdb.com/v4/games  headers: Client-ID, Authorization: Bearer <token>; body: search "Halo"; fields name,cover.image_id;
entries.notes: Rate limit 4 req/s, max 8 open requests. No browser CORS, so call from the backend. Has an external_games endpoint for Steam/GOG IDs.

entries.name: ScreenScraper API
entries.category: Metadata APIs
entries.licence: API may only be integrated in fully free, distributed apps unless ScreenScraper authorises otherwise
entries.takedown_note: n/a
entries.required_files: developer credentials (devid, devpassword, softname) requested on their forum + each user's own ssid/sspassword
entries.launch_cli: GET https://api.screenscraper.fr/api2/jeuInfos.php?devid=..&devpassword=..&softname=..&ssid=..&sspassword=..&output=json&crc=..&romnom=..&systemeid=..
entries.notes: Best for retro box art, screenshots and videos; matches by ROM hash. Daily quotas and thread limits depend on account level (about 20K/day for registered users per community reports).

entries.name: SteamGridDB API
